headline: Netweb Technologies shares rebound following strong Q2 results
hook: Netweb shares rally 13% in four days
summary: Netweb Technologies shares rose over 3% on Thursday, marking a 13% gain over four sessions. The company reported a Q2 FY27 profit of ₹136.7 crore on revenue of ₹1,323.3 crore. Growth is supported by a ₹2,629 crore order book and sustained demand for AI infrastructure. This rebound follows a period of sustained downward pressure on the stock price.
why_it_matters: Strong AI demand and order book support recent stock recovery.
